name: How long does it take to see results from Local AI Optimization efforts?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from Local AI Optimization efforts?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline to observe significant results from Local AI Optimization can vary based on several factors, such as the initial state of your local online presence, the competitiveness of your industry, and the specific geographic market. Typically, businesses begin to see initial improvements in local search rankings and visibility within 2-4 months. More substantial impacts on foot traffic, inquiries, and revenue usually become evident within 6-12 months as the AI-driven strategies fully mature and adapt.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial improvements are typically seen in 2-4 months, with more significant impacts on traffic and revenue becoming evident in 6-12 months.
